missions.name: Dead Stock Identification
missions.query: What are the top 3 product SKUs with the highest inventory levels that have not been sold within the last 12 months, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies Detection
missions.query: What are the product SKUs with size discrepancies (i.e., different sizes have different retail prices) and have sold at least 100 units within the last quarter?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Impact Analysis
missions.query: What is the average delay in lead time for suppliers who have not met their on-time delivery rate (OTDR) and how does it impact the inventory levels of their products?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches Identification
missions.query: Which product SKUs have breached their reorder point and have not been restocked within the last 30 days, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Inventory Obsolescence Risk Assessment
missions.query: What are the product SKUs that are no longer sold through any channel and have a remaining inventory level above 50 units, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Supplier Performance Correlation with Sales
missions.query: Do suppliers who have a higher on-time delivery rate (OTDR) also have higher sales volumes, and if so, what is the correlation coefficient?

missions.name: Product Price Variance Analysis
missions.query: What are the product SKUs with the highest price variance (i.e., difference between retail price and supplier cost) and have sold at least 100 units within the last quarter?

missions.name: Channel-Specific Sales Trends Identification
missions.query: What are the top 3 product SKUs that have shown significant sales trends (i.e., > 20% increase or decrease) on a specific channel (e.g., online, in-store) within the last quarter?

missions.name: Security Domain Scan
missions.query: Show users with risk_level HIGH and account_status ACTIVE

missions.name: Supplier Lead Time Correlation
missions.query: What is the correlation between supplier lead time and product sales volumes, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Inventory Holding Cost Analysis
missions.query: What are the top 3 product SKUs with the highest holding cost (retail price - supplier cost) within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Sales Channel Concentration
missions.query: What are the product SKUs that are sold through a single channel (e.g., online, in-store) and have a sales volume above 50 units within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate Impact
missions.query: What is the average impact on inventory levels for suppliers who have not met their on-time delivery rate (OTDR) within the last quarter?

missions.name: Product Life Cycle Analysis
missions.query: What are the product SKUs that have not been sold within the last 2 years and have a remaining inventory level above 20 units, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Price Elasticity Analysis
missions.query: What are the product SKUs with the highest price elasticity (i.e., change in sales volume due to price change) within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Supplier Performance Scorecard
missions.query: What are the top 3 suppliers with the highest performance score (based on lead time, OTDR, and sales volume) within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Inventory Turnover Analysis
missions.query: What are the product SKUs with the lowest inventory turnover rate (i.e., days inventory outstanding) within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Seasonal Sales Trend Analysis
missions.query: What are the product SKUs that show significant seasonal sales trends (i.e., > 20% increase or decrease) within the last year, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Supplier Risk Assessment
missions.query: What are the suppliers with the highest risk score (based on lead time, OTDR, and sales volume) within the last quarter, grouped by supplier?

missions.name: Compliance Domain Scan
missions.query: Show recent compliance violations or audit findings

missions.name: Operations Domain Scan
missions.query: Show system performance metrics and operational alerts

missions.query: Show users with risk_level HIGH and account_status ACTIVE
